text:
rachel: heads-up — after the netproxy ACL change this morning our DAST runs are spiking 502/connection errors and SAST jobs are failing to decrypt artifacts. seeing a flood of aborted scans. cc @sre-oncall

dan: i pushed the proxy ACLs at 01:12 UTC to lock down egress to external services. also rotated the KEK for the keyring at 01:05 earlier. possible we broke the scanner path or its KMS binding. investigating.

matt: quick logs from CI: 
```
[dynamic-scan] fetch target page -> 502 Bad Gateway (connect: connection refused)
[sast-runner] decrypt artifact bundle -> rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = KMS.Decrypt denied for requestor
```
both failures started ~01:15 UTC.

sec-bot: automated alert: scanner-failure-rate increased from 2% -> 78% in the last 10m. tickets will be noisy.

rachel: mitigation suggestion: (1) open short-lived proxy allowlist for scanner CIDR to staging endpoints, (2) apply time-limited KMS decrypt grant to scanner SA (30m), (3) re-run failing matrix and persist raw bundles to vuln tracker, (4) mark tickets with `scan:infra-flip` so we can filter infra regressions.

dan: i'll add the proxy exception and create an iam binding with a condition. sample command i'm about to run (will post audit id after):
```
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-inference \
  --member=serviceAccount:svc-scanner@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter \
  --condition='expression=request.time < timestamp("2026-03-23T03:00:00Z"),title=temporary_scanner_decrypt'
```

dan: audit log entry id: 0A1B2C3D4E5F6G (redacted) — binding created at 01:23 UTC. also opened proxy allow for 34.210.0.0/16 to staging cluster.

matt: for reproducibility, add this GH Action step to the scan workflow to stash raw evidence and exit nonzero only after uploading: 
```
- name: Persist scanner evidence
  run: |
    set -e
    tar -czf evidence.tgz scanner-output/ || true
    gh release upload --repo redwood-inference/vuln-evidence "evidence-${{ github.run_id }}.tgz" evidence.tgz || true
```
this prevents losing artifacts when a decrypt error occurs.

triage-bot: created issue SEC-4321: "Scan failures after proxy/KMS rotation" tags: [scan:infra-flip, priority-medium] assigned to @rachel

sre-oncall: i'll mute scanner noise alerts for 2 hours while you re-run. monitoring scan backlog and page SLOs. :white_check_mark: 

rachel: follow-ups: 
- dan: confirm proxy and iam commands in audit and remove temp grants after re-run (due in 1h)
- matt: add evidence persist step to scan templates and kick off re-runs (due EOD)
- triage-bot: ensure all auto-created vuln tickets from re-run include `scan:infra-flip` tag
- sre-oncall: keep noise muted and report on successful re-run counts (due 2h)

rachel: root cause hypothesis: concurrent infra changes (proxy ACL + KMS rotation) removed two critical paths for scanners. we'll consolidate a small checklist for rotations: preflight scanner service account bindings, proxy allowlist proof, and a smoke-run of scan pipeline. will post short postmortem and checklist here once re-runs finish. thanks everyone. :memo:
